tool_description: Find the NAICS code base on free  search or find all description of industry for a given NAICS code
name: Industry NAICS Search
title: Industry NAICS Search

api_list.name: Filter and Query NAICS & Description
api_list.description:
This endpoint will allow you to search by freeform text, eg. Hotel and get all the list of NAICS code, hash, and description back.
You can also filter the search if you have an NAICS code and want to get the description and the hash of the industry.

optional_parameters.name: naics
optional_parameters.description:
This parameter take full 6 digit NAICS code only.
Optional if q parameter is present.

optional_parameters.name: q
optional_parameters.description:
When freeform search without NAICS param, minimum 3 character to search.
Optional if NAICS param is present.
